blocks.text: Day 7 · Breakfast; check-out by 12:00 in most Lima hotels. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu (not included); on arrival, transfer to the hotel. On the border of Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay, within a national park of unique flora and fauna, 275 waterfalls, each with its own name, thunder into the gorge of the Devil’s Throat; their name means “big water” in Guarani. The contrast between the calm, almost lazy river above the falls and the roaring torrents below is spellbinding.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit the Brazilian side of the falls with an English-speaking guide.

The route follows the canyon to the viewpoints. On the way to the Devil’s Throat, you can see numerous cascades. Fine spray hangs in the air, and rainbows appear over the water in sunny weather. As the path approaches the main torrents, the roar and spray grow stronger. After several days in Peru’s dry highlands, the humid tropical scenery feels especially different.

You can add several excursions at an extra cost.

**Iguaçu Bird Park**

Price: **65 U$ per person**.

**Helicopter flight over Iguaçu Falls**

The excursion price is to be confirmed. For groups of 3 or more, the rate is also confirmed at booking.

The flight itself lasts about 10 minutes.
